text_block_list.text:
While walking through the shopping 
district... I spotted Mejiro McQueen in 
front of a fishmonger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How remarkably vivid... So this is the 
"real fish market" I've heard rumors 
about. And—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perched right in the middle is... a sea 
squirt! How utterly grotesque...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: !? The sea squirt spoke!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Trainer. Please don't 
scare me like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I merely came to see how the downtown 
area is doing. I never had the opportunity 
to visit during my childhood."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And while we're on the subject, um... I 
heard there's a seafood called sea squirt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Rich in vitamins and low in fat. I heard 
it's great for diet—er, for health, so I 
thought I'd give it a taste test.
choice_data_list:
It looks pretty intense... but is it even 
edible?

It looks pretty intense... but is it 
edible?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm feeling a bit unconfident... I 
knew about it in theory, but seeing this 
flabbiness in person...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I eat those wriggly little cilia, my 
stomach might not handle it. But if it's 
for my di—ahem, my health...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? Should I eat this with 
the resolve of rushing down Yodo's hill?
choice_data_list: Let's take a look at something else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, that is true. There are many things 
besides sea squirts that pique my 
interest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What might this be? This prickly, 
painful-looking thing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, sea urchins... So they are encased in 
shells like this, are they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what might this be? This thing 
with thirteen legs...

Having avoided danger and learned by 
observing various seafood, Mejiro McQueen 
gained precious knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: H-How utterly audacious...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you are right. No matter how 
bizarre it may be, shrinking back here 
would make me a laughingstock for 
generations.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I cannot allow a shameful record to be 
left upon the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now then, please try this sample slice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: *nibble, chew chew*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? It isn't nearly as shocking as it 
looks. In its own way, it's quite a 
delicacy. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I feel strength welling up within me! And 
to think it's good for dieting as well!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks to you, I was able to open 
the door to the unknown. Thank you very 
much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. Why don't you take this 
chance to enjoy some sea pineapple too, 
Trainer? Come now, there is no need to be 
frightened.

Mejiro McQueen smugly recommends the sea 
squirt. It seems the Mejiro bloodline has 
splendidly conquered the marine creature.
